04 · HOW IT WORKS

Three Steps to Multiplayer Savings

Fund your NGN wallet, launch a savings plan, and move money with friends in under 60 seconds.

STEP 01
Claim @tag & fund wallet
Register your unique @username, auto-provision an NGN wallet, and top up instantly via demo deposit or Paystack.
STEP 02
Create or join a plan
Launch a Personal or Group savings plan with a target & deadline. Invite friends with a 6-character code and fund from your wallet.
STEP 03
Chat, split & transfer P2P
Coordinate in real-time group chat, track contributor rankings, and send instant @username P2P transfers with live notifications.
